        attrs['s'] = '2'

    v.text = str(indices[value]) if ttype == 's' else value
sheet_data.append(row)

    # Insert before pageMargins when present.
    pm = ws_root.find(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}pageMargins')
    if pm is not None:
        ws_root.insert(list(ws_root).index(pm), hyperlinks)
    else:

for h in list(hyperlinks.findall(f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}hyperlink')):
    if h.get('ref') == 'F6':
        hyperlinks.remove(h)
h = ET.SubElement(hyperlinks, f'{{{NS_MAIN}}}hyperlink')
h.set('ref', 'F6')
h.set(f'{{{NS_REL}}}id', 'rId5')

contents['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(ws_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

# Update worksheet relationships.

rel.set('Id', 'rId5')
rel.set('Type', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink')
rel.set('Target', pdf_url)
rel.set('TargetMode', 'External')
contents['xl/worksheets/_rels/sheet1.xml.rels'] = ET.tostring(rels_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.xlsx', dir=str(xlsx.parent))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with ZipFile(tmpname, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name, data in contents.items():
            zout.writestr(name, data)
    shutil.move(tmpname, xlsx)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmpname):
        os.unlink(tmpname)

print('updated', xlsx)
print('backup', backup)

rel = ET.SubElement(rels_root, f'{{{NS_PKG_REL}}}Relationship')
rel.set('Id', 'rId5')
rel.set('Type', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink')
rel.set('Target', pdf_url)
rel.set('TargetMode', 'External')
contents['xl/worksheets/_rels/sheet1.xml.rels'] = ET.tostring(rels_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)

fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.xlsx', dir=str(xlsx.parent))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with ZipFile(tmpname, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name, data in contents.items():
            zout.writestr(name, data)
    shutil.move(tmpname, xlsx)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmpname):
        os.unlink(tmpname)

print('updated', xlsx)
print('backup', backup)
PY"
